versions.content: {DRAFT} If UdpNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and requests for synchronized PNC shutdown are pending, then the UdpNm module shall set for this message additionally the following data beneath the normal data within the call of UdpNm_TriggerTransmit:  Set the PNSR bit in the CBV to 1  Overwrite the PN information in the user data (after NM User Data has been fetched, if UdpNmComUserDataSupport is enabled) by setting bits that correspond to PNC IDs stored as pending request for a synchronized PNC shutdow n to 1 and all other bits to 0.

{ OBSOLETE replaced by SWS_UdpNm_00494 } If UdpNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and requests for synchronized PNC shutdown are pending, then the UdpNm module shall set for this message additionally the following data beneath the normal data within the call of UdpNm_TriggerTransmit:  Set the PNSR bit in the CBV to 1  Overwrite the PN information in the user data (after NM User Data has been fetched, if UdpNmComUserDataSupport is enabled) by setting bits that correspond to PNC IDs stored as pending request for a synchronized PNC shutdow n to 1 and all other bits to 0.
